verdict.rationale: LM Studio manages local models, chats, prompts, and configs (lm-studio-docs-6, lm-studio-docs-27), and models themselves use open formats like GGUF/MLX, but no evidence pack item documents an explicit export function for chat history, prompts, or configurations in open formats, nor any 'data portability' or account-deletion/export tooling.
